mapper.select: SELECT f.friend_id AS friendId, u.username, u.nickname, u.avatar, u.email, f.remark, f.status, f.created_at AS createdAt FROM im_friend f JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = f.friend_id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} AND f.status = #{status} ORDER BY f.updated_at DESC

SELECT f.user_id AS friendId, u.username, u.nickname, f.remark, f.status, f.created_at AS createdAt FROM im_friend f JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = f.user_id WHERE f.friend_id = #{userId} AND f.status = 'pending' ORDER BY f.created_at DESC

SELECT f.user_id AS friendId, u.username, u.nickname, f.remark, f.status, f.created_at AS createdAt FROM im_friend f JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = f.user_id WHERE f.friend_id = #{userId} AND f.status = 'rejected' ORDER BY f.updated_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO im_friend (user_id, friend_id, status, remark, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{friendId}, #{status}, #{remark}, NOW(), NOW())
